title: Checkers PDN 3.0 Coordinate Parser & Classical GAYP Master Openings Dataset
description:
Open-source Portable Draughts Notation (PDN 3.0) coordinate parser, 1–32 WCDF dark-square numbering specification, 18 classical GAYP (Go-As-You-Please) master openings dataset, and multi-jump tactical puzzle benchmarks for 8x8 American Checkers and English Draughts.

All opening evaluations and tactical benchmark sequences are verified using the Next Checkers Move 3400+ Elo WebAssembly SIMD128 NNUE engine and 6-piece WDL endgame tablebases.
